services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Sail through Fort Lauderdale at golden hour with your own drinks, playlist, and dedicated skipper. There is no more magical time to experience Fort Lauderdale’s waterways than golden hour. As the South Florida sun dips below the horizon, the sky lights up in brilliant shades of amber, violet, and crimson, casting a golden glow over luxury yachts, palm-lined canals, and illuminated downtown bridges. Our private Sunset Cruise offers an intimate, romantic, and celebratory evening on the water. Bring your favorite bottle of wine or champagne, stream your evening playlist, and let your licensed USCG captain navigate smoothly while you watch the sunset from the best seat in the city. Public

includes: Flat $25 gas fee included in online checkout
blurb: Guests rent private boats with a USCG licensed captain to explore Fort Lauderdale waterways, sandbars, and nature spots. Boats come with a cooler, Bluetooth sound system, and floating mat. Tours range from relaxing cruises to adventure and wildlife experiences lasting 2 to 8 hours.
